summary: Jurisdictional challenge to NGT directions; environmental clearance mandate under EIA Notification, 2006 Item 8(b); township plan revision required; interim stay on master plan reworking; Joint Committee inspection for road alignment, tree conservation, water bodies; tree plantation 1:10 ratio; prima facie illegality in tribunal's overreach into statutory master plan; appeal allowed in part.
legal_provisions_cited: Auroville Foundation Act, 1988 s.11(3), s.17(e), s.19(2)(c)
final_judgment: Appeal allowed in part; direction to revise township plan stayed; other directions upheld with compliance monitored through Joint Committee; status quo maintained pending final disposal.
